GenerateDataPointMappings@1_ContainerMat.description:
One strategy step for matching source containers to target entities.
Strategies are tried in order; the first one that resolves a target is used.

kind.description: Strategy discriminator: ExactName, NormalizedName, Regex, Manual.

sourceAttribute.description:
Attribute on the source container whose value drives the match
(default "Name").

targetAttribute.description: Attribute on the target entity to compare against (default "Name").

pattern.description:
For Regex: pattern applied to the
source attribute. The first capture group (or group 0 if no group) is the
comparison key, matched against the target attribute (normalized).

captureGroup.description:
For Regex: 1-based capture group index
(default 1). Use 0 for the entire match.

overrides.description:
For Manual: explicit container→target
overrides by source attribute value (typically Name or RtId).

GenerateDataPointMappings@1_ManualMatchO.description: Explicit container→target match override for the Manual strategy.

source.description: The value of the source attribute (typically Name) identifying the container.

targetRtId.description: The RtId of the target entity this container maps to. Takes precedence over TargetName.

targetName.description: The value of the target attribute identifying the target (used when TargetRtId is not set).

GenerateDataPointMappings@1_ControlMappi.description: One rule mapping a control + optional state to a target attribute on the matched target entity.

id.description:
Stable identifier for the rule. Used in the generated DataPointMapping Name (for idempotency)
and in the diagnostics output. Required.

when.description: Selector predicate over the control + state.

map.description: What this rule produces when When matches.

GenerateDataPointMappings@1_ControlMappi.description: Predicate over a control + state. All non-null fields must match (AND semantics).

stateName.description:
Optional state name to match (e.g. "tempActual"). When set, the rule fires only for
controls whose StatesAttribute
contains a state record with this name. When null, the rule fires once per matched
control and the suggestion uses DefaultSourceAttributePath.

categoryType.description:
Optional category type filter (compared against the category's CategoryType attribute).
Requires SourceCategoryCkTypeId to be set on the node configuration.

categoryNameRegex.description: Optional case-insensitive regex applied to the category's Name attribute.

controlNameRegex.description:
Optional case-insensitive regex applied to the control's Name attribute
(e.g. "(?i)(feuchte|humid)" to detect humidity sensors by naming).

GenerateDataPointMappings@1_ControlMappi.description: What a rule emits when it matches.

targetAttribute.description: Target attribute path on the target entity (e.g. "Temperature", "CO2Level").

expression.description:
Optional mXparser expression applied to the value at mapping evaluation time
(e.g. "value / 100"). Empty string ⇒ no transformation.

childTargetCkTypeId.description:
Optional: navigate from the matched container target to a child entity of this
CkTypeId before emitting the suggestion. Used in v2-style models where the
actual mapping target is a child of the matched container (e.g. a Loxone/Room
matches an EnergyIQ/Space, but the temperature reading must target an
EnergyIQ/TemperatureSensor associated with that Space).
            
When set, the node finds the first child entity of type
ChildTargetCkTypeId reachable from the matched target via the
ChildTargetAssociationRoleId role (inbound direction). If no
matching child exists, the rule produces no suggestion.
            
When null, the matched container target is used directly (v1 behaviour — back
compat with rules that target attributes on the container itself).

childTargetAssociationRoleId.description:
Optional: association role used to resolve the child target. Defaults to the
node's HierarchyAssociationRoleId
when null. Typically a v2 inverse role such as EnergyIQ/SpaceSensors,
EnergyIQ/SpaceActuators, or EnergyIQ/SpaceTerminals.

ValidateDataPointCoverage@1_CoverageRule.description:
A single coverage rule: for entities of the given CK type, declare which target
attribute paths a DataPointMapping must (or should) cover, plus optionally which
child entities must be associated via specific roles.

ckTypeId.description:
The fully qualified CK type id (e.g. "EnergyIQ/Space") this rule applies to.
Polymorphic — entities of derived types also match.

requiredAttributes.description:
Target attribute paths that MUST be present on at least one enabled mapping
inbound to the entity. Missing required attributes produce status="error".

recommendedAttributes.description:
Target attribute paths that SHOULD be present. Missing recommended attributes
produce status="warning" (only relevant when no required attributes are missing).

requiredAssociations.description:
Associations that MUST exist from this entity (e.g. a Space must have an
associated TemperatureSensor via the EnergyIQ/SpaceSensors role). Missing
required associations produce status="error".
            
Used in v2-style models where measurements live on sensor / actuator entities
reached via dedicated association roles, not as inline attributes — the
presence of those entities is the actual coverage signal, not a DataPointMapping
to an attribute path.

ValidateDataPointCoverage@1_RequiredAsso.description:
A required association from an entity to a child of a specific CK type via a
specific role. Used by RequiredAssociations.

associationRoleId.description:
Fully qualified association role id (e.g. "EnergyIQ/SpaceSensors").
Looked up INBOUND from the entity — i.e. the queried entity is the target of
the association, and children of the role's CkTypeId are the origin side.

targetCkTypeId.description:
CK type id of the child entity that must be present (e.g.
"EnergyIQ/TemperatureSensor"). The check is for at least one entity of this
type via the role; multiplicity beyond that isn't enforced here.

oneOf.title: UpdateRtEntityIfNewerNodeConfiguration
oneOf.description: UpdateRtEntityIfNewer node configuration. Filters a list of EntityUpdateInfo candidates by comparing each candidate against the existing RT entity that shares the same RtWellKnownName. Older candidates (whose is not strictly greater than the existing entity's value) are skipped from the RT-write path but kept — with the existing RtId — on the all-output path so a downstream archive write can still land the corrected slot in storage.

inputPath.description: JSONPath to the input List<EntityUpdateInfo<RtEntity>> of candidate updates. Required.

filteredOutputPath.description: JSONPath where the filtered list is written. Contains only entries that should reach the downstream ApplyChanges@2 (Insert + Update with strictly newer comparison value). Required.

outputPathAll.description: JSONPath where the complete list is written, including skipped entries (with the existing RtId substituted in). Consumed by downstream archive-write nodes that must store every slot even when the RT snapshot is not advanced. Required.

comparisonAttributePath.description: Attribute path on the candidate's RtEntity.Attributes dictionary that holds the monotonic comparison value (typically a UTC DateTime). Supports nested traversal of record-typed attributes via dot notation, e.g. "TimeRange.From". Required.

candidateAssociationsInputPath.description: JSONPath to an input List<AssociationUpdateInfo> of candidate parent associations (one per candidate entity, origin pointing at the candidate's freshly-generated RtId). Optional — when set, the node also writes a filtered association list at that contains only the associations whose origin entity stayed an Insert in the filtered output. Associations whose origin was rewritten to Update or dropped (SKIP) are removed, since the existing entity already has its parent association in the runtime store.

filteredAssociationsOutputPath.description: JSONPath where the filtered association list is written. Required when is set.

The filename sent to Discord is picked by precedence: / when set.The FileSystemItem's Name attribute — the intentional, renameable display label.The FileSystemItem's Content.Filename — the ingest-time blob metadata (fallback). Requires the System.Reporting CK package to be loaded on the tenant.

Each target is either: - A plain identifier string (when sourceAttributePath is empty or matches default) - A pipe-separated triple "identifier|stateName|stateId" (when the source entity has sub-states and sourceAttributePath references a specific state) Works generically for Loxone, MQTT, OPC-UA, or any adapter that uses DataPointMapping.

sourceCkTypeId.description: CkTypeId of the source entities that DataPointMappings map from (e.g. "Loxone/Control", "MQTT/Topic", "OpcUa/Node").

sourceIdentifierAttribute.description: Attribute name on the source entity that holds the external identifier (e.g. "LoxoneUuid", "TopicPath", "NodeId").

statesAttribute.description: Optional: Attribute name (RecordArray) on the source entity holding sub-states. When set, the node looks up sourceAttributePath in this record array. If not set, only plain identifiers are produced.

stateKeyAttribute.description: Attribute name within each state record that holds the state name/key (e.g. "StateName", "PropertyName"). Required when StatesAttribute is set.

stateValueAttribute.description: Attribute name within each state record that holds the state identifier/UUID (e.g. "StateUuid", "PropertyNodeId"). Required when StatesAttribute is set.

defaultAttributePath.description: The default attribute path name that maps to the source entity's main value (e.g. "currentValue"). When sourceAttributePath equals this, a plain identifier is produced instead of a state-specific triple.

matchAttributeName.description: Name of the record attribute to match against (e.g. "Name" or "ExternalId").

matchValue.description: Value to match against the MatchAttributeName. Static value.

matchValuePath.description: JSONPath to the value to match against. Takes precedence over MatchValue if both are set.

attributeUpdates.description: List of attribute updates to apply to the matched record.

oneOf.title: SimulateEnergyMeasurementsNodeConfiguration
oneOf.description: SimulateEnergyMeasurements node configuration. Generates per-15-min-slot EnergyMeasurement Insert candidates (and their parent ParentChild association candidates) for a configured set of MeteringPoints over a configured time window. Uses BDEW H0/G0/L0 load-profile or PV-curve math (deterministic, no calendar / season effects beyond the PV day-length cosine) so the produced amount values are realistic enough to validate chained rollups and time-range archive idempotency.

startDate.description: Inclusive UTC start of the simulation window. The first slot is [StartDate, StartDate + PT15M).

numDays.description: Number of full UTC days to simulate. Each day produces 96 slots per MeteringPoint × ObisCode pair.

energyMeasurementCkTypeId.description: CkTypeId of the EnergyMeasurement type the simulator emits (e.g. Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement).

timeRangeCkRecordId.description: CkRecordId of the TimeRange record on the EnergyMeasurement (e.g. Basic/TimeRange).

amountCkRecordId.description: CkRecordId of the Amount record on the EnergyMeasurement (e.g. Basic/Amount). Carries Value: Double + Unit: Enum.

amountUnit.description: UnitOfMeasure enum value to stamp on each Amount record. Default 1 (KWh in Basic.UnitOfMeasure).

parentAssociationRoleId.description: Association role used to wire each new EnergyMeasurement to its parent MeteringPoint (e.g. System/ParentChild).

entityUpdatesOutputPath.description: JSONPath where the list of EntityUpdateInfo<RtEntity> candidates is written.

associationUpdatesOutputPath.description: JSONPath where the list of AssociationUpdateInfo candidates is written.

meteringPoints.description: The MeteringPoints to simulate against. At least one entry required.

dataQuality.description: DataQuality enum value to stamp on every generated slot. Default 1 (BasicEnergy/DataQuality.L1 — 15-min meter readings).

valueAttributeName.description: Name of the record attribute that receives the map value (e.g. "StateUuid").

oneOf.title: GenerateDataPointMappingsNodeConfiguration
oneOf.description: Configuration for the GenerateDataPointMappings node. The node deterministically generates DataPointMapping suggestion records by: 1. Loading source containers (e.g. Loxone/Room) and target entities (e.g. EnergyIQ/Space). 2. Matching containers to targets using an ordered list of strategies — first match wins. 3. Traversing each matched container's hierarchy to reach control entities (e.g. Room → Category → Control via System/ParentChild). 4. Evaluating against each control + its state set, producing one suggestion entry per matched (rule, state) pair. The output shape is identical to the AnthropicAiQuery suggestion array, so the downstream pipeline (GetOrCreate + CreateUpdateInfo + CreateAssociationUpdate) can consume both sources interchangeably.

sourceContainerCkTypeId.description: CkTypeId of the container entities on the source side (e.g. "Loxone/Room"). One container ≡ one target candidate.

sourceControlCkTypeId.description: CkTypeId of the leaf entities to be mapped (e.g. "Loxone/Control"). These are reached by walking the hierarchy from each matched container.

sourceCategoryCkTypeId.description: Optional CkTypeId of an intermediate hierarchy level (e.g. "Loxone/Category"). When set, controls are reached via Container → Intermediate → Control. When null, controls are reached directly: Container → Control. Used for rules that reference categoryType / categoryName.

hierarchyAssociationRoleId.description: AssociationRoleId used to traverse the source hierarchy (default System/ParentChild). The traversal direction is INBOUND from the container's perspective — i.e. children are entities pointing at the container with this role.

statesAttribute.description: Attribute names on the source control that hold a RecordArray of states. Each state record must expose . Default "States" (Loxone convention).

stateNameAttribute.description: Attribute name within a state record that holds the state name (e.g. "Name" → "tempActual"). Default "Name".

defaultSourceAttributePath.description: Default sourceAttributePath emitted for rules that do not declare a stateName (single-state controls, e.g. Switch / InfoOnlyAnalog). Default "CurrentValue".

statisticsTargetPath.description: Optional path under which the node emits a JSON summary of the matching result (matched / unmatched containers, rule counts). For diagnostics only.

containerMatchingStrategies.description: Container ↔ target matching strategies, evaluated in order. First match wins.

controlMappingRules.description: Rules describing which control + state combinations produce which target attribute. Every rule whose matches a control produces one suggestion (or one per applicable state, if a stateName is set).

serverConfiguration.description: Name of the global GrafanaConfiguration entity containing Grafana connection parameters

tenantIdPath.description: Path to the tenant ID in the data context. If not set, the pipeline's tenant ID is used.

oneOf.title: ValidateDataPointCoverageNodeConfiguration
oneOf.description: Configuration for the ValidateDataPointCoverage node. Traverses a tree hierarchy (root + children via the configured ParentChild role) and for every visited node evaluates which target attribute paths are covered by inbound DataPointMappings. Emits a JSON report at TargetPath that can be persisted via the SetPipelineExecutionResult@1 node so the Studio can colour-code the tree.

rootRtId.description: RtId of the tree root entity to validate. Leave empty to read from the data context at .

rootCkTypeId.description: CK type id of the root entity (e.g. "Basic/Tree" or a derived type). Required.

rootRtIdPath.description: Optional JsonPath in the data context to read the root rtId from when is empty.

childRoleId.description: Association role used to traverse parent→child relationships. The query uses INBOUND direction on the parent: children are entities whose outbound ParentChild points at the parent. Defaults to System/ParentChild.

childCkTypeId.description: CK type id of children to traverse (polymorphic; e.g. "Basic/TreeNode"). Defaults to Basic/TreeNode.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to traverse from the root (1 = only direct children). Defaults to a generous value that handles normal building hierarchies.

mappingRoleId.description: Association role used to find DataPointMappings pointing at a node. Defaults to System.Communication/MapsTo.

mappingCkTypeId.description: CK type id of mapping entities (polymorphic). Defaults to System.Communication/DataPointMapping.

includeDisabledMappings.description: Whether disabled DataPointMappings (Enabled=false) contribute to coverage. Defaults to false — disabled mappings do not count.

rules.description: Coverage rules per CK type. Entities not covered by any rule receive status="info" with empty missing/present lists.

mode.description: The mode of operation: find the minimum or maximum value. Defaults to .
